claim: Media Studio v0.2.1 candidate commit 7e9f5b0df63385474a25b330bdc50bf5c8d5cace is ready for native Arch/Dolphin/user-systemd release: VAAPI/NVENC capability checks are fail-closed and observable, config and environment fallback policy is honored through queue and watch units, target-size fallback preserves rate controls, atomic output and existing menus are retained, and packaging is bounded to a buildable Arch package plus an explicitly experimental wrapper-backed Flatpak manifest. This is a pre-publicization review; the v0.2.1 tag is intentionally not pushed yet.

output.summary: Hardware checks, fallback behavior, atomic output, queue/watch propagation, Rust checks, and representative native runs are supported, but the packaging gate and existing-menu retention require revision.
material_defects: The packaging CI check expands $tool in grep, while the manifest contains literal /app/bin/$tool; the bound packaging job therefore cannot pass as written.
install() deletes an existing media-studio.desktop and uninstall() does not restore it, creating a Dolphin menu loss path contrary to the no-regression claim.
evidence_gaps: The reported Arch artifact is media-studio-proof-0.2.1-1, not the supplied media-studio-git PKGBUILD; its pkgver() would produce a revisioned Git version, so the exact package build is unverified.
Flatpak validation checks YAML and a literal commit string, but not that the pinned tree is v0.2.1 and contains the referenced wrapper and desktop files.
supported_claims: VAAPI/NVENC encoder checks, VAAPI render-node validation, overrides, fail-closed behavior, and observable fallback are supported by source and runs.
Target-size rate flags and atomic output commits are supported by source and evidence.
Rust formatting, tests, clippy, release build, and native consumer checks are evidenced.
Queue and watch propagation of the VAAPI device is evidenced.
Flatpak syntax, wrapper contract, and experimental limitation are statically supported only.
prohibited_claims: Exact Arch release-package readiness or version validation.
Public v0.2.1 tag, release assets, or installer verification.
required_changes: Fix the packaging CI wrapper check and rerun it.
Preserve or explicitly migrate media-studio.desktop, with an install/uninstall regression test.
Build the exact supplied PKGBUILD from the pinned candidate source and reconcile its reported package version.
residual_risks: Flatpak host integration remains experimental and runtime-unverified.
Post-push publication and asset readback remain intentionally pending.
